text:
bonfire of silences,

crackling of laments,

by the path of flesh,

blood in suspense,

one reaches the world.


thus darkness lights its white,

thus the endless coda is born,

thus the fly lays eggs in the thread of light.


the earth turns,

the eye of god does not stop.

what would we do, I ask,

without this enormous darkness.

translation.title: Bonfire of Silences
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the birth-through-flesh movement and the necessary enormous darkness.
